text: I started yesterday and still cannot access the shared HR drive or the onboarding portal. My manager confirmed my account was created, but every login attempt ends with an access denied message. IT support told my colleague this might be a group membership issue. I need access by tomorrow for mandatory compliance training. Could someone check my permissions?
label: Access Management

text: My laptop fan has been running at full speed since this morning and the bottom of the device is uncomfortably hot to touch. It shut down twice during a client presentation without warning. Battery health dropped from 92 percent to 71 percent in a week according to the diagnostics tool. I work mostly on-site, so I cannot switch to a desktop. Can I get a replacement or a repair slot this week?
label: Hardware

text: Since the maintenance window yesterday, our entire second-floor office loses Wi-Fi every 20-30 minutes for about a minute at a time. Wired connections are unaffected. The access point lights look normal, and rebooting it did not help. Roughly 40 people are affected. Is there a rollback plan for whatever changed last night?
label: Network

text: Our team shared mailbox stopped syncing new messages around noon - the web version shows everything, but Outlook desktop shows nothing after 11:58. We already tried recreating the profile and clearing the cache. This is the inbox where customer contract renewals arrive. Any chance a rule or a license change broke the sync?
label: Email

text: The nightly inventory sync between the WMS and the ERP failed again last night, so this morning picking lists show yesterday stock levels. The error log mentions a timeout on the batch job INV_SYNC_DAILY. Warehouse had to pause inbound processing for two hours. This is the third failure this week - can someone look at the job configuration before tomorrow shift?
label: Application

text: The label printer at packing station 7 prints only the left half of every shipping label since the ribbon was replaced this morning. We tried two different ribbons and recalibrated the sensor twice. Test prints from the driver menu show the same problem. Online orders are piling up because we have to hand-write labels. Is there a spare print head in stock?
label: Printer/Peripherals

text: I received an email that looks exactly like our IT department password expiry notice, but the link points to a domain I have never seen. I almost entered my credentials before noticing the address bar. A colleague in Finance got the same email an hour earlier. I reported it via the phishing button, but wanted to flag it here too in case others fell for it. Should we force-reset passwords for everyone who received it?
label: Security

text: Our call center agents desk phones randomly drop calls after exactly 32 seconds - it has happened to six different people today, all mid-conversation with customers. Softphone users on laptops are not affected. We rebooted the phones and checked the cabling in the rack. The pattern is too consistent to be a coincidence. Could this be a SIP timeout misconfiguration on the voice gateway?
label: Telephony
